steps.en: The driver's newest mobile number is fetched
steps.why_en: The lookup is switched off by configuration, so only the stored number is used.
steps.why_id: Pencarian dimatikan konfigurasi, jadi hanya nomor tersimpan yang dipakai.

steps.en: Each driver is grouped so they get a single SMS
steps.id: Tiap driver dikelompokkan supaya dapat satu SMS
steps.why_en: A driver with different due dates still gets more than one SMS.
steps.why_id: Driver dengan tanggal jatuh tempo berbeda tetap dapat lebih dari satu SMS.

steps.en: The SMS lists the unpaid notices and mentions the letter
steps.id: SMS memuat notice yang belum dibayar dan menyebut surat
steps.why_en: Whether the message text mentions the letter cannot be seen in the code.
steps.why_id: Apakah teks pesan menyebut surat tidak terlihat di code.

steps.en: The SMS is sent to the driver in a batch run
steps.id: SMS dikirim ke driver dalam satu batch
steps.why_en: The reminder job and text sending are switched off in production settings.
steps.why_id: Job reminder dan pengiriman SMS dimatikan di pengaturan produksi.

steps.en: Only valid, non-opted-out drivers are texted
steps.id: Hanya driver valid yang tidak opt-out yang dikirimi SMS
